description: This file defines data models and response structures related to compliance and history of boards and blocks within the focalboard project, including response types, history record types, and query options.

classes.name: BoardsComplianceResponse
classes.description: Response structure for boards compliance query, including pagination and results.

classes.name: BoardsComplianceHistoryResponse
classes.description: Response structure for boards compliance history query, including pagination and results.

classes.name: BlocksComplianceHistoryResponse
classes.description: Response structure for blocks compliance history query, including pagination and results.

classes.name: BoardHistory
classes.description: Represents historical data of a board, including identifiers, deletion status, and update timestamps.

classes.name: BlockHistory
classes.description: Represents historical data of a block, including identifiers, type, deletion status, and update timestamps.

classes.name: QueryBoardsForComplianceOptions
classes.description: Options for querying boards compliance, including team filter and pagination.

classes.name: QueryBoardsComplianceHistoryOptions
classes.description: Options for querying boards compliance history, including modification time filter, deletion inclusion, and pagination.

classes.name: QueryBlocksComplianceHistoryOptions
classes.description: Options for querying blocks compliance history, including modification time, deletion inclusion, team and board filters, and pagination.
